verdict.rationale: Oneleet is a compliance platform, so a manual-evidence workflow is a fair question to ask of it. However, the pack documents no workflow for manual artifacts: there is no evidence of owners, due dates, renewal reminders or expiry tracking. The only related items are a passing note that controls can hold 'evidence, review history, assignments' and Fieldwork's claim of AI-automated collection 'on your schedule'. Both are adjacent features, not the requested manual-evidence lifecycle.

support.subject: As an operations lead, evidence that can't be automated has a real workflow — owners, due dates, renewal reminders, and expiry tracking on every manual artifact
